Issue #2540 describes a bug where a voted-in OOS finding was silently dropped at Step 9a.1 (neither filed as a GitHub issue nor folded inline). Three coordinated changes are required:

1. **Policy hardening in `skills/implement/SKILL.md`**: Add a Terminal disposition invariant paragraph in the OOS triage policy block (around L441-452) stating that once a finding lands in an accepted-OOS artifact, Step 9a.1 MUST NOT re-apply rules 1-2, and every non-security voted-in OOS source entry MUST terminate at exactly one of: (a) a filed GitHub issue, or (b) an inline-fold commit with an `Inline-triage rule N:` body line. Add a new NEVER-list bullet: "NEVER silently drop a voted-in OOS finding." Tighten the L452 carve-out sentence to lead with consequence. Add a NEVER-list ratchet: "NEVER set OOS_PENDING=false without a passing oos-disposition-gate.sh invocation (carved out for forked_target=true and repo_unavailable=true)."

2. **New gate script `skills/implement/scripts/oos-disposition-gate.sh`** with sibling `oos-disposition-gate.md` contract and `test-oos-disposition-gate.sh` harness (≥6 scenarios: pass-via-filed, pass-via-inline, pass-fork, pass-repo-unavailable, pass-security-only, fail-silent-drop). Gate accepts `--accepted-files`, `--filed-urls-file`, `--commit-range`, `--fork-mode`, `--repo-unavailable`. Logic: skip when fork-mode=true or repo-unavailable=true; count `### OOS_N:` entries minus security-routed ones; count filed URLs in the sentinel file; count `Inline-triage rule N:` commit lines; pass if filed_url_count>0 OR inline_fold_count>=non_security_accepted_count; fail (exit 1) if non_security_accepted_count>0 AND filed_url_count==0 AND inline_fold_count==0. Exit 2 for bad args. Wire into SKILL.md Step 8+ OOS checkpoint (around L1755) after /issue block, before state_set OOS_PENDING false.

3. **New `scan_oos_silent_drop` in `.claude/skills/audit-runs/scripts/audit-scan-run.sh`**: reads `review-findings-full.jsonl` (skip if missing), counts accepted OOS via jq, counts filed URLs in `oos-issues.ndjson`, counts `Inline-triage rule N:` lines in `codex-commit-message.md`; emits fail scan result when accepted>0 AND filed==0 AND inline==0. Register in `scans.tsv` and wire through the `case $scan_name in` dispatcher.

Also: `scripts/test-implement-structure.sh` gains a literal-pin assertion for the new Terminal-disposition-invariant text and NEVER-list bullet. After all changes: `make lint-bash32`, `make agent-lint`, relevant `test-*` targets must pass.
